_comment: Lean-layer exclusions for the iostreams LOCALE-SEVERANCE deviation (lean/README.md deviation 11). Lean <ios>/<ostream>/<istream> are CLASSIC-LOCALE ONLY: ios_base stores no std::locale, imbue() is a documented no-op, and getloc() always returns the classic locale. AUDITED: every entry below fails ONLY because it imbues a CUSTOM numpunct facet into a std::ios and then asserts LOCALE-SPECIFIC number formatting (custom thousands-separator, grouping, decimal point, or true/false names) — behavior the lean streams deliberately make classic. Each was proven overlay-induced by a with-overlay vs without-overlay run of the localization gate (the 9 that flip are exactly these; put_pointer.pass.cpp in the same directory is locale-INDEPENDENT and still PASSES, so it is NOT excluded). None is a bug in the overlay: with base streams (imbue honoured) they pass, and plain classic-locale num_put formatting is verified in lean/test/iostream.cpp. These test std::num_put<CharT>::put(iter, ios, ...), which reads ios.getloc() — lean's classic-only getloc() is why the imbued custom numpunct is not consulted.
README deviation 11 (locale severance): imbues a custom numpunct with do_truename()/do_falsename() overrides into a std::ios and asserts num_put emits those custom bool names. Lean ios::getloc() is classic-only (imbue is a no-op), so num_put uses the classic 'true'/'false'. Genuine locale-specific behavior, made classic by the deviation.

README deviation 11 (locale severance): imbues a custom numpunct (do_thousands_sep()='_', do_grouping()="\1\2\3") and asserts grouped integer output. Lean ios::getloc() is classic-only, so num_put groups per classic (none). Genuine locale-specific behavior, made classic.

README deviation 11 (locale severance): custom-numpunct grouping/thousands-sep asserted on long long output; lean getloc() classic-only, so grouping is classic. Genuine locale-specific behavior, made classic.
README deviation 11 (locale severance): custom-numpunct grouping/thousands-sep asserted on unsigned long output; lean getloc() classic-only. Genuine locale-specific behavior, made classic.
README deviation 11 (locale severance): custom-numpunct grouping/thousands-sep asserted on unsigned long long output; lean getloc() classic-only. Genuine locale-specific behavior, made classic.

README deviation 11 (locale severance): custom-numpunct decimal-point/thousands-sep/grouping asserted on double output; lean getloc() classic-only, so decimal point is '.' and grouping is classic. Genuine locale-specific behavior, made classic.
README deviation 11 (locale severance): custom-numpunct decimal-point/grouping asserted on hexfloat double output; lean getloc() classic-only. Genuine locale-specific behavior, made classic.
